role: Match tokenized NL utterances against graph-stored syntactic templates for pattern extraction.
detail: SyntacticTemplateMatcher class matches whitespace-tokenized input against ProceduralTemplate nodes (domain=="syntax") stored as ProcedureStep ASTs linked by HAS_OPERAND edges. Result type MatchResult carries template_id, role_bindings (role->lemma), confidence, and tokens. Tokenization is whitespace-only (spaCy removed per CANON A.12/A.27); templates degrade on dependency/POS matching but lemma matching works. Root step must be step_type==match_root; child steps support match_edge, match_optional, extract_role, match_property. Confidence = 1.0 + 0.01*specificity (bonus per required lemma_filter matched). Tiebreaker: prefer more role bindings when confidence equal.
gotchas: POS/dependency filtering skipped due to whitespace tokenization only (spaCy removed); all tokens get pos=X, dep=ROOT|dep; head_idx semantics simplified (first word root, all others children); templates relying on rich dependency relations degrade to lemma-only matching; Phase 1.7-E4 scaffolding, OLA is active path
